content:
# Advanced AI Catalog Server - Features

## 🚀 Production-Grade C++ Server

Complete rewrite in C++ with advanced features, integrated with MedusaServ/Lamia.

## ✨ Features

### 1. Hot Reload
- **Automatic file watching**: Monitors C++, header, and Lamia files
- **Zero-downtime updates**: Reloads configuration without restarting
- **Real-time change detection**: Instantly detects file modifications

**Usage:**
```cpp
// Server automatically watches for changes
// Triggers reload when files are modified
```

### 2. Temporary URLs with Time Expiry
- **Time-limited access**: URLs expire after specified time
- **Access count limits**: Optional maximum access count
- **Secure tokens**: Cryptographically secure token generation

**API:**
```bash
# Create temporary URL
POST /api/temp-url?target=/path/to/file&ttl=3600&max_accesses=10

# Access temporary URL
GET /api/temp-url/<token>
```

**Example:**
```json
{
  "token": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  "url": "/api/temp-url/a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  "expires_in": 3600
}
```

### 3. Folder-Level Time Expiry
- **Per-folder expiry**: Set expiry time for specific folders
- **Optional authentication**: Require auth token for expired folders
- **Automatic cleanup**: Expired folders automatically removed

**API:**
```cpp
// Set folder expiry
server.SetFolderExpiry("/path/to/folder", 7200, true, "auth_token");

// Check access
bool allowed = server.CheckFolderAccess("/path/to/folder", "auth_token");
```

### 4. Password-Protected Settings
- **Admin password**: Required for all settings changes
- **SHA256 hashing**: Secure password storage
- **Settings API**: Protected endpoints for configuration

**API:**
```bash
# Get settings (requires password)
GET /api/settings
Headers: X-Admin-Password: <password>

# Update settings (requires password)
POST /api/settings
Headers: X-Admin-Password: <password>
Body: { "port": 80, "enable_hot_reload": true, ... }
```

### 5. MedusaServ/Lamia Integration
- **Native integration**: Built on MedusaServ architecture
- **Lamia support**: Full Lamia file watching and execution
- **Performance**: C++ native performance

## 📋 API Endpoints

### Catalog API
- `GET /api/catalog` - Get project catalog
- `GET /api/file?path=<file>` - Get file contents (respects folder expiry)
- `GET /api/stats` - Server statistics

### Temporary URLs
- `POST /api/temp-url?target=<path>&ttl=<seconds>&max_accesses=<count>` - Create temp URL
- `GET /api/temp-url/<token>` - Access temporary URL

### Settings (Password Protected)
- `GET /api/settings` - Get settings (requires `X-Admin-Password` header)
- `POST /api/settings` - Update settings (requires `X-Admin-Password` header)

## 🔧 Configuration

### Server Settings
```json
{
  "port": 80,
  "bind_address": "0.0.0.0",
  "enable_hot_reload": true,
  "enable_temp_urls": true,
  "enable_folder_expiry": true,
  "admin_password_hash": "<sha256_hash>",
  "temp_url_default_ttl_seconds": 3600,
  "folder_expiry_check_interval_seconds": 60,
  "log_file_path": "logs/server.log",
  "enable_cors": true,
  "allowed_origins": ["*"]
}
```

## 🚀 Usage

### Start Server
```bash
# Basic start
./build/Release/tools/ai_catalog_server_advanced

# With password
./build/Release/tools/ai_catalog_server_advanced --password "admin123"

# With config file
./build/Release/tools/ai_catalog_server_advanced --config config/server.json

# Disable hot reload
./build/Release/tools/ai_catalog_server_advanced --no-hot-reload
```

### Create Temporary URL
```bash
curl -X POST "http://86.141.195.93:80/api/temp-url?target=src/main.cpp&ttl=3600&max_accesses=5"
```

### Set Folder Expiry
```cpp
// C++ API
server.SetFolderExpiry("/path/to/folder", 7200, true, "secret_token");
```

### Update Settings
```bash
curl -X POST "http://86.141.195.93:80/api/settings" \
  -H "X-Admin-Password: admin123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"port": 80, "enable_hot_reload": true}'
```

## 🔒 Security Features

1. **Password Protection**: All settings changes require admin password
2. **Time Expiry**: Temporary URLs and folders expire automatically
3. **Access Limits**: Temporary URLs can have maximum access counts
4. **Folder Protection**: Folders can require authentication tokens
5. **Secure Tokens**: Cryptographically secure token generation

## 📊 Statistics

Server provides real-time statistics:
- Total requests
- Temporary URLs created
- Active temporary URLs
- Folders with expiry
- Server uptime
- Last reload time

## 🌐 Integration

### With MedusaServ
- Uses MedusaServ HTTP request/response structures
- Integrates with MedusaServ virtual host system
- Leverages MedusaServ performance optimizations

### With Lamia
- Watches Lamia files for changes
- Supports Lamia execution
- Hot reloads Lamia scripts

## 🎯 Production Ready

- ✅ Multi-threaded request handling
- ✅ Hot reload without downtime
- ✅ Secure password protection
- ✅ Time-based access control
- ✅ Automatic cleanup of expired resources
- ✅ Comprehensive logging
- ✅ Statistics and monitoring

## 📝 Example Workflow

1. **Start server with password:**
   ```bash
   ./ai_catalog_server_advanced --password "secure_password"
   ```

2. **Create temporary URL for Gemini/Grok:**
   ```bash
   POST /api/temp-url?target=src/main.cpp&ttl=3600
   ```

3. **Share temporary URL:**
   ```
   http://86.141.195.93:80/api/temp-url/<token>
   ```

4. **Set folder expiry:**
   ```cpp
   server.SetFolderExpiry("/sensitive/folder", 1800, true, "token123");
   ```

5. **Update settings:**
   ```bash
   POST /api/settings (with X-Admin-Password header)
   ```

The server automatically handles hot reload, expiry cleanup, and all advanced features!

# BertieBot Code Correction Pipeline

**Detection + AI = Fix.** BertieBot combines build-failure detection, bullshit patterns, will-fail heuristics, and the AI assistant into an active code correction pipeline.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  DETECTION LAYER                                                             │
│  • build_failure_scanner.py (400k files, triage scoring)                     │
│  • will_fail_patterns.py (BRACE_MISMATCH, EXPECTED_TOKEN, AI_MISTAKE, etc.)  │
│  • run_bullshit_audit.py (bullshit + will-fail integration)                  │
│  • qcpm_analyze (LamiaFabrica MCP)                                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                        │
                                        ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  MCP TOOLS (lamiafabrica-code-intelligence / BertieBot MCP)                  │
│  • code_correction_get_batch — next batch of issues for AI to fix            │
│  • code_correction_propose_fix — propose/apply fix with backup               │
│  • analyze_local_cpp_file — per-file bullshit + will-fail                    │
│  • qcpm_analyze — C++ QC/PM analysis                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                        │
                                        ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  AI ASSISTANT (Cursor, Kimi, Cline, etc.)                                    │
│  • Receives triaged issues, reads files, proposes edits                      │
│  • Uses Cursor edit tools or code_correction_propose_fix(apply=true)         │
│  • Implements → Validate → Debug → Continue                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## MCP Tools

### `code_correction_get_batch`

Returns the next batch of build-failure issues for the AI to fix. Triage-sorted by severity × confidence × project sensitivity.

**Parameters:**
- `limit` (optional): Max issues per batch (default 10)
- `max_files` (optional): Max files to scan (default 50,000)

**Response:**
- `batch`: List of `{ path, project, sensitivity, triage_score, errors, fixes, patterns, ai_instruction }`
- `count`: Number of issues returned
- `pipeline`: `"BertieBot Code Correction (Detection + AI = Fix)"`

### `code_check_active_files`

**Run as many tools as possible in one call.** When MCP is invoked, use this to run code_correction_get_batch + analyze_file (bullshit, will-fail, QC) on every active file.

**Parameters:**
- `file_paths` (optional): Array of active/open file paths from the IDE. If empty, uses paths from the triaged batch.
- `batch_limit` (optional): Max build-failure issues to fetch (default 15).
- `max_analyze` (optional): Max files to run analyze_file on (default 20).
- `max_files_scan` (optional): Max files to scan for the batch (default 10,000).

**Response:** `batch` (triaged issues), `analyses` (per-file quality, errors, fixes, ai_instruct), `tools_run`, `summary`. The server crams code_correction_get_batch and analyze_file into a single response.

### `code_correction_propose_fix`

Propose or apply a fix for a file. If `apply=true`, creates a timestamped backup before modification.

**Parameters:**
- `file_path` (required): Path to file to fix
- `fix_instruction` (required): What to fix (from `code_correction_get_batch`)
- `apply` (optional): If true, create backup; if false, return proposal only

**Response:**
- `file_path`, `fix_instruction`, `current_exists`, `apply`
- `backup_path` (if `apply=true`): Path to timestamped backup
- `message`: Instruction for AI (use Cursor edit tools, etc.)

## Supported Projects

Configured in `v0.4.1/config/build_failure_scan_config.json`:

| Project      | Sensitivity | Root                                              |
|--------------|-------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| LamiaFabrica | 10          | C:/LamiaFabrica                                   |
| PsiForceDB   | 9           | C:/McMaker Projects/Projects/PsiForceDB_1-0-0      |
| MedusaServ   | 9           | C:/McMaker Projects/Projects/MedusaServ...         |
| GravityCDN   | 8           | C:/McMaker Projects/Projects/GravityCDN            |
| Tools        | 8           | C:/McMaker Projects/Tools                          |
| BertieBot    | 7           | C:/McMaker Projects/Projects/BertieBot             |
| Build        | 6           | C:/Build                                           |
| Projects     | 5           | C:/McMaker Projects/Projects                       |

## Will-Fail Patterns

- **BRACE_MISMATCH** (score 10): Unmatched `{}[]()`
- **EXPECTED_TOKEN** (score 9): Missing `;`, `)`, etc.
- **AI_MISTAKE** (score 8): Common AI-generated error patterns
- **LINTER_STYLE** (score 6): Style issues that can cause build failure

## Workflow

1. **Get batch**: `code_correction_get_batch` → triaged issues
2. **Read file**: AI uses fs-read or similar
3. **Propose fix**: AI applies correction via Cursor edit tools
4. **Optional backup**: `code_correction_propose_fix(apply=true)` before risky changes
5. **Validate**: Build, run tests, check logs
6. **Continue**: Next issue in batch

## Protocols

- **bertiebot-protocols.mdc**: Implement → Validate → Debug → Continue
- **AGENTS.md**: C++26, Lamia only; no new Python/Shell/Batch MCP servers
- **DO_NOT_BREAK_BERTIEBOT.md**: Extend existing stack; preserve vector tech

## Build & server

- **MCP server (code checks):** Python only — no compile. Cursor uses the **lamiafabrica-code-intelligence** MCP server, which runs `v0.4.0a/code_intelligence/mcp_protocol_wrapper.py`. When the MCP is called, use **`code_check_active_files`** to run as many tools as possible on active files (batch + analyze_file per file).
- **C++ stack:** Build with CMake from `v0.4.1`: `cmake -B build -S v0.4.1 && cmake --build build`. The MCP wrapper does not require the C++ build; it uses Python scanners and the vector backend.

## Validation

```powershell
# Build-failure scanner (500–2000 files)
python v0.4.1/vector_paper/build_failure_scanner.py --max-files 500 --workers 2

# Bullshit + will-fail audit
python v0.4.1/vector_paper/run_bullshit_audit.py

# MCP tools (via Python)
python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'v0.4.0a/code_intelligence')
from mcp_protocol_wrapper import MCPProtocolWrapper
w = MCPProtocolWrapper()
r = w._code_correction_get_batch(limit=3, max_files=500)
print('OK' if not r.get('error') else r.get('error'))
"
```

## Changelog

- **2026-02-14**: OSError handling for symlinks/junctions (lfssl); `run_report` passes `max_files`/`workers`; MCP qcpm_analyze syntax fix; skip_dirs +lfssl, .venv.
- **2026-02-14**: will_fail: skip brace check for .py (regex/f-strings false positives); merge conflict check uses exact line match (avoids docstring `=======` false positives).
- **2026-02-14**: MCP tool `code_check_active_files`: run code_correction_get_batch + analyze_file on active files in one call; pass `file_paths` from IDE or omit to use batch paths. Server crams as many checks as possible when MCP is called.

---

*BertieBot Code Correction — Detection + AI = Fix*

**Status:** ✅ VALIDATED - The One Build That Binds Them All

## What is "The One Symphony"

BertieBot The One Symphony is the unified build system that produces all components from a single CMake configuration:

- **One Entry Point:** `v0.5.0/src/bertiebot_main.cpp` - "BertieBot Main Entry Point - v0.5.0"

    ↓
Step 2: register_commitment (when committing to work)
    ↓
Step 3: get_commitment_status (before saying "done")
    ↓

content:
---
name: Billing Client-Backbone C++26
overview: Plan for a production billing/invoicing module that uses existing Client Management as the single source of client identity and policy, and is implemented to C++26 standards for type safety, performance, and maintainability.
todos: []
isProject: false
---

# Billing/Invoicing Module — Client-Backbone, C++26

**For Kimi — quick reference:** Section 9 (type definitions), Section 10 (repository signatures), Section 11 (BillingEngine API), Section 12 (PostgreSQL schema), Section 13 (REST API), Section 14 (settings), Section 16 (invoice creation algorithm), Section 17 (rate resolution), Section 19 (file-by-file order). Use existing [ClientRepository](v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_repository.hpp), [ClientManagementEngine](v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_management_engine.hpp), [TaskDBResult](v0.5.0/meddav/database/task_database.hpp) patterns; BillingResult = std::expected with BillingError. All client_id must be validated before any billing write.

---

## 1. Design principle: client as backbone

Billing does **not** duplicate client identity or lifecycle. All client-scoped billing operations go through the existing client layer.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph client_layer [Client Layer - Existing]
        ClientRecord[ClientRecord]
        ClientRepo[ClientRepository]
        ClientEngine[ClientManagementEngine]
    end
    subgraph billing_layer [Billing Layer - New]
        BillingEngine[BillingEngine]
        InvoiceRepo[InvoiceRepository]
        TimeEntryRepo[TimeEntryRepository]
    end
    ClientEngine --> resolve_client[resolve_client_for_task]
    ClientEngine --> validate_client[validate_client_exists]
    ClientRepo --> list_tasks[list_tasks_for_client]
    ClientRepo --> list_projects[list_projects_for_client]
    BillingEngine --> ClientRepo
    BillingEngine --> ClientEngine
    BillingEngine --> InvoiceRepo
    BillingEngine --> TimeEntryRepo
    list_tasks --> BillingEngine
    resolve_client --> BillingEngine
```



- **Client identity:** Every invoice, time entry, and rate lookup is keyed by `client_id`. That ID is always validated via `ClientManagementEngine::validate_client_exists` or `ClientRepository::read` before any billing write.
- **Client resolution for tasks:** Billing uses `ClientManagementEngine::resolve_client_for_task(task)` to get the billable client for a task (today: via `project.client_id`; future: optional `task.client_id`).
- **Client status:** `ClientRecord.status` (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, INACTIVE) drives billing policy: e.g. do not create new invoices for SUSPENDED; optionally auto-suspend on overdue (set status via client engine).
- **Client group:** `ClientRecord.organization_id` is the group for shared billing config (default currency, payment terms, rate tiers). Billing config resolution: **task → project → client → organization → global**.
- **No new “billing client” entity:** ClientRecord remains the only client entity. Billing adds **client-scoped configuration** (rates, payment terms, tax) and **client-scoped financial state** (invoices, payments, credit), not a parallel client table.

Existing production anchors:

- [v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_entity.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_entity.hpp): `ClientRecord`, `ClientContact`, `ClientStatus`, `organization_id`, `metadata`, `ContactInfo` (address, country for tax).
- [v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_repository.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_repository.hpp): `list_tasks_for_client`, `list_projects_for_client`, `client_exists`, `read`.
- [v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_management_engine.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_management_engine.hpp): `resolve_client_for_task`, `validate_client_exists`, `get_client_stats`.
- [v0.5.0/meddav/pm/project_management_engine.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/pm/project_management_engine.hpp): `Project.client_id`, `Project.Settings.billable_hours`, `hourly_rate`, `default_currency`; `PMTask::TimeEntry` (billable, duration), `PMTask.hourly_rate`, `total_billable_amount`.

---

## 2. C++26 implementation standard

The billing module will be implemented to **C++26** (with C++20/23 fallbacks only where toolchains lag). This is a differentiator: type-safe, explicit error handling, and compile-time guarantees where possible.


| Feature                 | Use in billing                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **std::expected**       | All billing operations return `BillingResult<T>` = `std::expected<T, BillingError>`. No throwing APIs for business logic; callers use `if (auto r = create_invoice(...); r) { ... } else { handle(r.error()); }`. |
| **Concepts**            | `BillableSource` (has task_id, client_id, is_billable, billing_mode); `RateProvider` (get_rate(client_id, mode)); `Invoiceable` (can produce billable items). Used to constrain engine and repository interfaces. |
| **constexpr**           | Rate calculations (e.g. duration × rate, tax amount) in a small `RateCalculator` so they can be constexpr where inputs are compile-time; runtime path uses same functions.                                        |
| **[[nodiscard]]**       | Every function that returns BillingResult or a value must be [[nodiscard]] so misuse (ignoring errors) is a compiler warning.                                                                                     |
| **std::format**         | Money display, invoice number formatting, log/audit strings. No sprintf.                                                                                                                                          |
| **Structured bindings** | When handling results, e.g. `auto [inv, line_count] = build_invoice(...);` or `if (auto r = ...; r) { auto& inv = *r; }`.                                                                                         |
| **std::chrono**         | All timestamps and durations (invoice date, due date, time entry duration). No raw time_t in public API.                                                                                                          |
| **Minor-unit money**    | Amounts stored as `int64_t` minor units (cents). No float/double for money.                                                                                                                                       |
| **Ranges (C++20)**      | Where useful: filter uninvoiced entries, aggregate by client, transform to line items.                                                                                                                            |
| **No raw pointers**     | References or std::reference_wrapper for injected dependencies (repos, client engine); no owning raw pointers.                                                                                                    |


Protocol already uses `MedDavResult<T,E>` = `std::expected<T,E>` ([meddav_protocol.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/protocol/meddav_protocol.hpp)). Billing will define `BillingError` and `BillingResult<T>` in the same style as `TaskDBError` / `TaskDBResult<T>` ([task_database.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/database/task_database.hpp)).

## 3. Billing module structure (client-centric)

- **Placement:** New directory `v0.5.0/meddav/billing/` (alongside `clients/`, `pm/`).
- **Depends on:** `clients/` (ClientRepository, ClientManagementEngine, ClientRecord), `database/` (TaskDBResult, PostgresTaskRepository, TaskRecord), `pm/` (Project, PMTask, TimeEntry shape), `protocol/` (MDEIndex), `settings/` (SettingCategory::FEATURES_BILLING).

Proposed files:

- **billing_types.hpp** — Money (minor units + currency), BillingMode (hourly, fixed task, fixed incident, not billable), TimeEntry (persisted shape with client_id), BillableItem, Invoice, InvoiceLine, Payment, ClientBillingConfig (rates, payment terms, tax exempt in metadata).
- **billing_concepts.hpp** — Concepts BillableSource, RateProvider, Invoiceable (as above).
- **billing_config.hpp** — ClientBillingConfig, GlobalBillingConfig (default currency, tax rules, minimum charge). Client config can be stored in DB and keyed by client_id; global in settings under FEATURES_BILLING.
- **billing_repositories.hpp** — Interfaces: BillingConfigRepository (get_client_config, upsert_client_config), TimeEntryRepository (create, get_uninvoiced_for_client, mark_invoiced), InvoiceRepository (create, get, list_for_client, next_invoice_number), PaymentRepository (record, list_for_invoice).
- **billing_engine.hpp/.cpp** — BillingEngine: takes ClientRepository, ClientManagementEngine, BillingConfigRepository, TimeEntryRepository, InvoiceRepository, PaymentRepository. Methods: time_entries_to_billable_items(client_id), create_invoice(client_id, items, created_by), get_rate(client_id, mode) [resolves client → org → global], resolve_client_for_task(task) [delegates to ClientManagementEngine]. All return BillingResult.
- **postgres_billing_repository.hpp/.cpp** — Implementations for config, time entries, invoices, payments (PostgreSQL; schema below).
- **billing_api.hpp/.cpp** — REST handlers; register on existing server Router. All client_id in paths or body validated via ClientManagementEngine::validate_client_exists before use.

ClientStats today ([client_management_engine.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/clients/client_management_engine.hpp)) has total_clients, active_clients, total_tasks, total_projects. **Option A:** Add a separate `BillingEngine::get_client_billing_summary(client_id)` returning outstanding_balance, total_invoiced, credit_balance (and optionally extend ClientStats later). **Option B:** Keep ClientStats as-is and only expose billing summary via billing API. Plan recommends **Option A** so the client portal or admin can show one “client summary” that includes billing without duplicating client fetching.

## 4. Data flow and persistence

**Time entries**

- Current: `PMTask::TimeEntry` is in-memory only. Billing needs persisted entries with `client_id` for aggregation.
- At **log time:** Resolve client via `ClientManagementEngine::resolve_client_for_task(task)`; persist to `billing_time_entries` with task_id, project_id, client_id, user_id, started_at, ended_at, duration, description, billable, billing_mode (from task/project), rate_tier (optional), invoice_id (null until invoiced).
- Rate at invoice time: resolve from ClientBillingConfig / Project / PMTask (rate hierarchy). Do not store rate on time entry if you want to re-price at invoice time; otherwise store snapshot for audit.

**Invoices**

- Create: Select uninvoiced time entries (and optionally fixed-task/incident items) for one client_id; build line items; compute subtotal, tax, total; create invoice and lines; mark time entries as invoiced.
- Invoice number: e.g. `INV-{YYYY}-{NNNN}`; persist in `billing_invoices` with client_id, status, dates, amounts (minor units), currency.
- All invoice operations require valid client_id from ClientRepository.

**Payments and credit**

- Payments reference invoice_id and client_id. Credit balance: client-level balance applied to future invoices; when applying credit to an invoice, create a “credit” line or a payment record with type=credit.

**Client billing config**

- Table `billing_client_config`: client_id (FK to clients), default_currency, hourly_rate_minor, fixed_task_minor, fixed_incident_minor, payment_terms (e.g. "Net 30"), default_due_days, tax_exempt, rate_tiers (JSONB). If organization_id is set, optional org-level config can override global defaults before client overrides.

## 6. Rate and config resolution (client-first)

Resolution order for “what rate do I use for this task/time entry?”:

1. **Task-level:** PMTask.hourly_rate if set and > 0.
2. **Project-level:** Project.Settings.hourly_rate, Project.Settings.default_currency.
3. **Client-level:** BillingConfigRepository::get_client_config(client_id) → hourly_rate_minor, fixed_task_minor, etc.
4. **Organization-level:** (Optional) get config for client.organization_id.
5. **Global:** SettingsManager (FEATURES_BILLING): default_currency, default_minimum_charge, default_tax_rate.

Client status must be respected: if ClientRecord.status != ACTIVE, billing engine can refuse to create new invoices or apply late fees (policy choice; recommend refusing new invoices for SUSPENDED/INACTIVE).

## 7. Integration points

- **ClientManagementEngine:** BillingEngine holds a reference. Uses validate_client_exists before any create; resolve_client_for_task when building billable items from tasks; get_client_stats could be extended or BillingEngine::get_client_billing_summary called from the same client API.
- **ClientRepository:** BillingEngine uses read(client_id) to get ClientRecord for invoice address, contact_info, metadata (e.g. tax ID), and list_tasks_for_client / list_projects_for_client when aggregating work for a client.
- **PM / Task:** Time entry creation can remain in PM; billing provides TimeEntryRepository and a way to “push” or “sync” PMTask time entries into billing_time_entries with resolved client_id. Alternatively, billing exposes “log time” API that resolves client and writes to billing_time_entries (and optionally updates PMTask if desired).
- **Settings:** Register billing settings under SettingCategory::FEATURES_BILLING (e.g. default_currency, default_tax_rate, late_fee_fixed_minor, late_fee_percentage).
- **Validation/Audit:** Invoice create/finalize and payment record can emit audit events (same pattern as log_client_event) for compliance.

## 9. Type definitions (exact fields for Kimi)

### 9.1 billing_types.hpp

**Money**

- `int64_t amount_minor` (cents/smallest unit)
- `std::string currency` (ISO 4217, e.g. "USD", "GBP")
- Methods: `to_major() -> double`, `from_major(double, string_view) -> Money`, `format() -> string` (e.g. "150.00 USD")

**BillingMode** (enum class uint8_t)

- `HOURLY = 0`, `FIXED_TASK = 1`, `FIXED_INCIDENT = 2`, `NOT_BILLABLE = 3`

**BillingError**

- `BillingErrorCode code`
- `std::string message`
- `std::chrono::system_clock::time_point timestamp`
- Optional: `std::string client_id`, `std::string invoice_id` for context

**BillingErrorCode** (enum class uint16_t)

- `SUCCESS = 0`
- `CLIENT_NOT_FOUND = 100`, `CLIENT_SUSPENDED = 101`, `RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED = 102`, `INVALID_TIME_ENTRY = 103`
- `INVOICE_NOT_FOUND = 200`, `INVOICE_ALREADY_FINALIZED = 201`, `INSUFFICIENT_ITEMS = 202`, `INVOICE_NUMBER_CONFLICT = 203`
- `PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE = 300`, `CURRENCY_MISMATCH = 301`
- `TAX_CALCULATION_FAILED = 400`
- `INTERNAL_ERROR = 900`

**BillingResult**** = `**std::expected<T, BillingError>`. Follow same pattern as `TaskDBResult` in [task_database.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/database/task_database.hpp) (use Protocol::MedDavResult or std::expected).

**TimeEntry** (persisted billing time entry)

- `std::string entry_id` (MDE INDX)
- `std::string task_id`, `std::string project_id`, `std::string client_id`
- `std::string user_id`
- `std::chrono::system_clock::time_point started_at`, `ended_at`
- `std::chrono::minutes duration`
- `std::string description`
- `bool billable`
- `BillingMode billing_mode`
- `std::optional<std::string> rate_tier`
- `std::optional<std::string> invoice_id` (null until invoiced)
- `std::chrono::system_clock::time_point created_at`, `std::string created_by`

**BillableItem**

- `std::string item_id`, `std::string source_type` ("time_entry" | "fixed_task" | "fixed_incident"), `std::string source_id`
- `std::string description`
- `std::chrono::minutes quantity_minutes` (for hourly; 0 for fixed)
- `int32_t quantity_units` (for fixed; 1 default)
- `Money unit_price`, `Money total_amount`
- `BillingMode billing_mode`

**InvoiceStatus** (enum class uint8_t)

- `DRAFT = 0`, `PENDING = 1`, `PAID = 2`, `PARTIAL = 3`, `OVERDUE = 4`, `CANCELLED = 5`

**Invoice**

- `std::string invoice_id` (MDE INDX), `std::string invoice_number` (e.g. "INV-2025-00042")
- `std::string client_id`
- `InvoiceStatus status`
- `std::chrono::system_clock::time_point invoice_date`, `due_date`
- `std::optional<std::chrono::system_clock::time_point> paid_at`
- `std::vector<InvoiceLine> lines`
- `Money subtotal`, `tax_total`, `total`
- `std::string currency`
- `std::optional<double> tax_rate_override`
- `std::optional<std::string> payment_terms`
- `std::chrono::system_clock::time_point created_at`, `std::string created_by`

**InvoiceLine**

- `std::string line_id`, `uint32_t line_number`
- `BillableItem item`
- `std::optional<double> tax_rate`, `Money tax_amount`

**Payment**

- `std::string payment_id`, `std::string invoice_id`, `std::string client_id`
- `Money amount`, `std::chrono::system_clock::time_point paid_at`
- `std::string gateway` ("manual" | "stripe" | etc.), `std::string transaction_id`
- `std::string status` ("completed" | "pending" | "failed" | "credit")

**ClientBillingSummary** (returned by get_client_billing_summary)

- `std::string client_id`
- `Money outstanding_balance`, `total_invoiced`, `total_paid`, `credit_balance`
- `uint64_t invoice_count`, `uint64_t overdue_count`

### 9.2 billing_concepts.hpp

- **BillableSource:** requires `task_id() -> string`, `client_id() -> string`, `is_billable() -> bool`, `billing_mode() -> BillingMode`.
- **RateProvider:** requires `get_rate(client_id, mode) -> optional<RateVariant>` (RateVariant = variant of HourlyRate, FixedRate structs).
- **Invoiceable:** requires `to_billable_items() -> range of BillableItem`.

### 9.3 billing_config.hpp

**ClientBillingConfig**

- `std::string client_id`
- `std::string default_currency` ("USD")
- `std::optional<int64_t> hourly_rate_minor`, `minimum_charge_minutes` (default 15)
- `std::optional<int64_t> fixed_task_minor`, `fixed_incident_minor`
- `std::string payment_terms` ("Net 30"), `int default_due_days` (30)
- `bool tax_exempt` (false)
- `nlohmann::json rate_tiers` (optional: {"rush": 15000, "standard": 10000} cents per hour)
- `std::chrono::system_clock::time_point created_at`, `updated_at`

**GlobalBillingConfig** (from SettingsManager)

- `std::string system_currency`, `int default_minimum_charge_minutes`, `double default_tax_rate` (0.0)

## 11. BillingEngine public API

Constructor: `BillingEngine(ClientRepository&, ClientManagementEngine&, BillingConfigRepository&, TimeEntryRepository&, InvoiceRepository&, PaymentRepository&, Settings::SettingsManager&)`.

All methods return `BillingResult<T>` and are `[[nodiscard]]`:

- `BillingResult<std::vector<BillableItem>> time_entries_to_billable_items(const std::string& client_id)` — Fetch uninvoiced time entries for client; resolve rate per entry (task → project → client config → global); build BillableItem list. Validate client exists first.
- `BillingResult<Invoice> create_invoice(const std::string& client_id, std::span<const BillableItem> items, const std::string& created_by, std::optional<double> tax_rate, std::optional<std::chrono::days> due_days)` — Validate client; if client status != ACTIVE refuse; get next_invoice_number; build Invoice with lines; persist; mark time entries as invoiced (by source_id). Apply tax if tax_rate or client config.
- `BillingResult<ClientBillingSummary> get_client_billing_summary(const std::string& client_id)` — Validate client; sum invoices by status (outstanding = PENDING + OVERDUE total minus sum of payments); total_invoiced = sum all invoice totals; total_paid = sum payments; credit_balance from client credit table or metadata.
- `BillingResult<RateVariant> get_rate(const std::string& client_id, BillingMode mode, std::optional<std::string> rate_tier)` — Resolution order: client config → org config (if client.organization_id) → global. Return HourlyRate or FixedRate variant.
- `std::optional<std::string> resolve_client_for_task(const Database::TaskRecord& task)` — Delegate to `client_engine_.resolve_client_for_task(task)`.

## 12. PostgreSQL schema (copy-paste ready)

Assume `clients` table exists (from [postgres_client_repository.cpp](v0.5.0/meddav/clients/postgres_client_repository.cpp): table `clients`, PK `id`). Add to a new SchemaVersion in `get_schema_versions()` (see [database_initializer.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/database/database_initializer.hpp)):

```sql
-- Billing client config (one row per client; FK to clients.id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_client_config (
    client_id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    default_currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'USD',
    hourly_rate_minor BIGINT,
    minimum_charge_minutes INT DEFAULT 15,
    fixed_task_minor BIGINT,
    fixed_incident_minor BIGINT,
    payment_terms VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'Net 30',
    default_due_days INT DEFAULT 30,
    tax_exempt BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    rate_tiers JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Time entries (billable work; client_id resolved at log time)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_time_entries (
    entry_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    project_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    client_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    ended_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    billable BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    billing_mode SMALLINT DEFAULT 0,
    rate_tier VARCHAR(32),
    invoice_id VARCHAR(32),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    created_by VARCHAR(64)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_time_entries_client ON billing_time_entries(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_time_entries_uninvoiced ON billing_time_entries(client_id) WHERE invoice_id IS NULL AND billable = TRUE;
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_time_entries_task ON billing_time_entries(task_id);

-- Invoices
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_invoices (
    invoice_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_number VARCHAR(32) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    client_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    status SMALLINT DEFAULT 0,
    invoice_date DATE NOT NULL,
    due_date DATE NOT NULL,
    paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    subtotal_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    tax_total_minor BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
    total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    tax_rate_override DOUBLE PRECISION,
    payment_terms VARCHAR(64),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    created_by VARCHAR(64)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_invoices_client ON billing_invoices(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_invoices_status ON billing_invoices(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_invoices_due ON billing_invoices(due_date);

-- Invoice lines
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_invoice_lines (
    line_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES billing_invoices(invoice_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    line_number INT NOT NULL,
    source_type VARCHAR(32),
    source_id VARCHAR(32),
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity_minutes INT DEFAULT 0,
    quantity_units INT DEFAULT 1,
    unit_price_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    tax_rate DOUBLE PRECISION,
    tax_amount_minor BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
    billing_mode SMALLINT
);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_invoice_lines_invoice ON billing_invoice_lines(invoice_id);

-- Invoice number sequence (e.g. per-year counter)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_invoice_sequence (
    year INT PRIMARY KEY,
    next_value INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);

-- Payments
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing_payments (
    payment_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES billing_invoices(invoice_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    client_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id),
    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    gateway VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'manual',
    transaction_id VARCHAR(128),
    status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'completed'
);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_payments_invoice ON billing_payments(invoice_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_billing_payments_client ON billing_payments(client_id);

## 13. REST API specification

Base path: `/api/v1/billing`. All handlers must validate `client_id` with `client_engine_.validate_client_exists(client_id)` when client_id is in path or body; return 404 and `{"error": "Client not found"}` if invalid.


| Method | Path                                         | Description                  | Request body                                                                                       | Response                                            |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/billing/config/:client_id`          | Get client billing config    | —                                                                                                  | 200 ClientBillingConfig JSON; 404 if client missing |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/billing/config/:client_id`          | Upsert client billing config | ClientBillingConfig JSON                                                                           | 200 OK or 400 error                                 |
| POST   | `/api/v1/billing/time-entries`               | Create time entry            | task_id, project_id, user_id, started_at, ended_at, description, billable                          | 201 TimeEntry JSON; 400 if client resolution fails  |
| GET    | `/api/v1/billing/time-entries`               | List time entries            | Query: client_id, task_id, uninvoiced_only (bool)                                                  | 200 array of TimeEntry                              |
| GET    | `/api/v1/billing/time-entries/uninvoiced`    | Uninvoiced for client        | Query: client_id (required)                                                                        | 200 array of TimeEntry                              |
| POST   | `/api/v1/billing/invoices`                   | Create invoice               | client_id, created_by, optional tax_rate, due_days, optional line_items (if not from time entries) | 201 Invoice JSON                                    |
| GET    | `/api/v1/billing/invoices/:id`               | Get invoice                  | —                                                                                                  | 200 Invoice JSON; 404                               |
| GET    | `/api/v1/billing/invoices`                   | List invoices                | Query: client_id (required), status, limit, offset                                                 | 200 array of Invoice                                |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/billing/invoices/:id/finalize`      | Set status PENDING (send)    | —                                                                                                  | 200 Invoice; 400 if already finalized               |
| POST   | `/api/v1/billing/payments`                   | Record payment               | invoice_id, amount_minor, currency, paid_at, gateway, transaction_id                               | 201 Payment JSON                                    |
| GET    | `/api/v1/billing/clients/:client_id/summary` | Billing summary              | —                                                                                                  | 200 ClientBillingSummary JSON                       |


Route registration pattern (same as [ValidationApi](v0.5.0/meddav/validation/validation_auditing_system.cpp) and [QualityGateApi](v0.5.0/meddav/quality_gate/quality_gate_api.cpp)): `router.get("/api/v1/billing/...", [this](auto& req, auto& res) { handle_...(req, res); });`. Path params: `req.path_params.at("id")` or `req.path_params.at("client_id")`. Query: parse from `req.uri` or request query API if present.

- [meddav_protocol.hpp](v0.5.0/meddav/protocol/meddav_protocol.hpp) already has `EntityType::INVOICE = 10`. Add to the same enum: `TIME_ENTRY = 14`, `INVOICE_LINE = 15` (or reuse existing if preferred). Generate IDs with `Protocol::MDEIndex::generate(EntityType::INVOICE)` etc. for invoice_id, entry_id, line_id, payment_id.

---

## 16. Invoice creation algorithm (step-by-step)

1. Validate `client_id` via `ClientManagementEngine::validate_client_exists(client_id)`. If false, return `BillingErrorCode::CLIENT_NOT_FOUND`.
2. Optionally load `ClientRecord`; if `status == SUSPENDED` or `INACTIVE` and setting `billing.allow_invoice_for_suspended_client` is false, return `CLIENT_SUSPENDED`.
3. If items are not provided: call `get_uninvoiced_for_client(client_id)`; then `time_entries_to_billable_items(client_id)` to get BillableItems. If empty, return `INSUFFICIENT_ITEMS`.
4. Get `next_invoice_number()` from InvoiceRepository (atomic: e.g. SELECT/UPDATE billing_invoice_sequence for current year).
5. Get client config for currency, payment_terms, default_due_days, tax_exempt. If tax not exempt, use tax_rate parameter or client/default tax rate.
6. Build Invoice: invoice_id = MDEIndex::generate(INVOICE), invoice_date = now, due_date = now + due_days, subtotal = sum(line.total_amount), tax_total = subtotal * tax_rate (or per-line), total = subtotal + tax_total. Status = DRAFT.
7. Build InvoiceLine for each BillableItem; line_id = MDEIndex::generate(INVOICE_LINE).
8. Persist Invoice and InvoiceLines (transaction).
9. For each TimeEntry in items (source_type == "time_entry"), call `mark_invoiced(entry_id, invoice_id)`.
10. Return created Invoice.

---

## 17. Rate resolution algorithm (step-by-step)

1. Load client: `ClientRepository::read(client_id)`. If missing, return error.
2. For hourly rate: Check client config `hourly_rate_minor`; if set, build HourlyRate { rate_per_hour in Money, minimum_charge from config } and return. Else step 3.
3. If client has `organization_id`, load org-level billing config (if you add `billing_org_config` table) and use its hourly_rate_minor. Else step 4.
4. Load GlobalBillingConfig from SettingsManager (billing.default_currency, billing.default_minimum_charge_minutes). Use system default rate if configured, else return RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED.
5. For fixed task/incident: same order (client config fixed_task_minor / fixed_incident_minor → org → global). Build FixedRate { amount in Money }.

---

## 18. Include and namespace conventions

- Billing headers use MedDav-relative includes: `#include "../clients/client_entity.hpp"`, `#include "../database/task_database.hpp"`, `#include "../protocol/meddav_protocol.hpp"`. Do not use `v0.5.0/meddav/` in includes (per project convention).
- Namespace: `namespace MedDav { namespace Billing { ... } }`.
- BillingEngine and API may need to forward-declare or include ClientManagementEngine and ClientRepository; use `#include "../clients/client_management_engine.hpp"` and `#include "../clients/client_repository.hpp"`.

---

## 19. File-by-file checklist and dependencies


| Order | File                                   | Depends on                                                                                                          | Notes                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1     | billing_types.hpp                      | protocol (MedDavResult), chrono, string, optional, vector                                                           | Money, enums, TimeEntry, BillableItem, Invoice, InvoiceLine, Payment, BillingError, BillingResult                                                                |
| 2     | billing_concepts.hpp                   | billing_types.hpp, concepts                                                                                         | BillableSource, RateProvider, Invoiceable                                                                                                                        |
| 3     | billing_config.hpp                     | billing_types.hpp                                                                                                   | ClientBillingConfig, GlobalBillingConfig                                                                                                                         |
| 4     | billing_repositories.hpp               | billing_types.hpp, billing_config.hpp                                                                               | All repository interfaces                                                                                                                                        |
| 5     | (SchemaVersion in DatabaseInitializer) | —                                                                                                                   | Add billing_* SQL to get_schema_versions()                                                                                                                       |
| 6     | postgres_billing_repository.hpp        | billing_repositories.hpp, postgres_task_repository (pool)                                                           | Declare PostgresBillingConfigRepository, PostgresTimeEntryRepository, PostgresInvoiceRepository, PostgresPaymentRepository (or one combined class per interface) |
| 7     | postgres_billing_repository.cpp        | postgres_billing_repository.hpp, pqxx                                                                               | Implement all; use pool_.acquire(), pqxx::work txn                                                                                                               |
| 8     | billing_engine.hpp                     | billing_repositories.hpp, clients/client_management_engine.hpp, clients/client_repository.hpp, settings_manager.hpp | BillingEngine class                                                                                                                                              |
| 9     | billing_engine.cpp                     | billing_engine.hpp                                                                                                  | Implement rate resolution, time_entries_to_billable_items, create_invoice, get_client_billing_summary                                                            |
| 10    | billing_api.hpp                        | billing_engine.hpp, server/meddav_server.hpp (Router, HttpRequest, HttpResponse)                                    | BillingApi class, register_routes                                                                                                                                |
| 11    | billing_api.cpp                        | billing_api.hpp, nlohmann/json                                                                                      | register_routes + all handle_*; validate client_id, parse body, call engine, set res.status and res.body                                                         |
| 12    | (Settings registration)                | settings_manager.hpp                                                                                                | get_billing_settings() returning vector of SettingDefinition; register in main or init                                                                           |


---

## 20. Edge cases and validation

- **Duplicate invoice number:** next_invoice_number must be atomic (lock row in billing_invoice_sequence or use RETURNING). On conflict return INVOICE_NUMBER_CONFLICT.
- **Empty line items:** create_invoice refuses 0 items (INSUFFICIENT_ITEMS).
- **Currency mismatch:** If mixing currencies in one invoice, refuse (CURRENCY_MISMATCH). All line items and invoice must use same currency (client default_currency).
- **Payment exceeds balance:** When recording payment, if sum_paid_for_invoice + amount > invoice.total_minor, optionally refuse or allow (overpayment → credit). Document choice.
- **Time entry already invoiced:** mark_invoiced must only update rows where invoice_id IS NULL; otherwise skip or error.
- **Client deleted:** Use ON DELETE RESTRICT on billing_invoices and billing_payments so client cannot be deleted while invoices exist; or soft-delete client (status DELETED) and allow billing reads for audit.

---

## 21. What stays out of scope (for this plan)

- Payment gateway integration (Stripe, etc.): only record payments; no gateway calls.
- PDF generation: can be a separate follow-up.
- Automated reminder emails: design only (templates and triggers); implementation later.
- Incident entity: can be modeled as task with custom_fields type=incident; fixed_incident pricing in config.

---

## 22. Summary

- **Client as backbone:** All billing is keyed and validated by ClientRecord and ClientManagementEngine; no parallel client concept.
- **C++26:** std::expected, concepts, constexpr, [[nodiscard]], minor-unit money, no raw pointers.
- **New module:** `meddav/billing/` with types, concepts, config, repositories, engine, and API; persistence in new PostgreSQL tables; rate/config resolution client → org → global.
- **ClientStats:** Extend via BillingEngine::get_client_billing_summary(client_id) and optionally surface in client API so “client management” includes billing summary in one place.

# C++26 Feature Enhancements - Complete Implementation

**Date:** 2026-02-26  
**Status:** ✅ ALL HIGH/MEDIUM PRIORITY ENHANCEMENTS COMPLETED  
**Standard:** C++26 (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 26)

---

## Executive Summary

All high and medium priority C++26 enhancements identified in the penultimate review have been implemented. BertieBot now uses native C++26 throughout with modern features replacing legacy patterns.

---

## 1. Build & C++ Standard (COMPLETED)

### CMake Updates
| File | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| `v0.5.0/CMakeLists.txt` | C++20/23 mix | **C++26 Native** |
| `v0.5.0/meddav/CMakeLists.txt` | C++23 | **C++26** |
| `v0.5.0/lamia/CMakeLists.txt` | lamia_open: C++17 | **C++26** |

### Compiler Flags Added
```cmake
# GCC/Clang
-std=c++2c -fcoroutines -Wall -Wextra

# MSVC
/std:c++latest /W4
```

---

## 2. Error Handling - std::expected (COMPLETED)

### API Changes: bool → std::expected<void, std::string>

| File | Function | Change |
|------|----------|--------|
| `server_manager.hpp` | `CredentialVault::initialize()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |
| `server_manager.hpp` | `InfrastructureManager::initialize()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |
| `server_manager.hpp` | `ServerManager::initialize()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |
| `absorber.hpp` | `create_psiforcedb_tables()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |
| `absorber.hpp` | `execute_sql()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |
| `purple_pages_exporter.hpp` | `execute_insert()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |
| `postgres_task_repository.hpp` | `validate_connection()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |
| `meddav_server.hpp` | `setup_tls()` | `bool` → `std::expected<void, std::string>` |

### Usage Pattern
```cpp
// Before:
if (!initialize()) {
    // handle error without details
    return false;
}

// After:
auto result = initialize();
if (!result.has_value()) {
    // detailed error message
    std::println("Init failed: {}", result.error());
    return;
}
```

---

## 3. Formatting - std::format/println (COMPLETED)

### Files Migrated

| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `v0.5.0/tests/test_quality_gate_complete.cpp` | All `cout` → `println()` |
| `v0.4.1/bertiebot_comprehensive_main.cpp` | Banner, errors, status → `println()`/`format()` |
| `v0.4.1/utilities/file_absorber_system.cpp` | LogOperation() → `std::format()` |
| `v0.5.0/core/raii_pgconnection.hpp` | Example code → `println()` |
| `v0.5.0/server_manager/src/server_manager.cpp` | Status messages → `format()` |

### Migration Patterns
```cpp
// Before:
std::cout << "Found " << count << " items at " << path << std::endl;

// After:
std::println("Found {} items at {}", count, path);
```

```cpp
// Before:
std::ostringstream oss;
oss << "Error code: " << code << ", message: " << msg;
std::cerr << oss.str() << std::endl;

// After:
std::cerr << std::format("Error code: {}, message: {}", code, msg) << std::endl;
```

---

## 4. Concurrency - jthread & stop_token (COMPLETED)

### Thread Migration Summary

| File | Thread Type | Change |
|------|-------------|--------|
| `bertiebot_comprehensive_main.cpp` | HTTP, IRC, workers | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |
| `file_absorber_system.cpp/.hpp` | Scanner, processor, sync | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |
| `purple_pages_integration.cpp/.hpp` | Sync thread | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |
| `ssh_executor.cpp` | Async execution | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |
| `absorber.cpp/.hpp` | Monitor, thread pool | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |
| `minimal_bridge_main.cpp` | Status, workers | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |
| `postgres_task_repository.cpp/.hpp` | Health monitor | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |
| `task_server.cpp/.hpp` | HTTP, WebSocket | `std::thread` → `std::jthread` |

### Key Changes
```cpp
// Before:
std::thread worker([this]() {
    while (running_) {
        // work
    }
});
// ...
worker.join();  // Manual join

// After:
std::jthread worker([this](std::stop_token st) {
    while (!st.stop_requested()) {
        // work
    }
});
// Auto-join in destructor
```

---

## 5. Ranges & Algorithms (COMPLETED)

### Algorithm Replacements (~42 sites)

| Algorithm | Count | Example Transformation |
|-----------|-------|------------------------|
| `std::sort` → `std::ranges::sort` | 14 | `std::sort(v.begin(), v.end(), cmp)` → `std::ranges::sort(v, cmp)` |
| `std::find` → `std::ranges::find` | 10 | `std::find(v.begin(), v.end(), x)` → `std::ranges::find(v, x)` |
| `std::count` → `std::ranges::count` | 5 | `std::count(v.begin(), v.end(), x)` → `std::ranges::count(v, x)` |
| `std::transform` → `std::ranges::transform` | 8 | Raw loops → `views::drop(1)` |
| `insert(begin, end)` → `ranges::copy` | 6 | `v.insert(v.end(), begin, end)` → `std::ranges::copy(rng, back_inserter(v))` |
| `erase-remove` → `std::erase` | 2 | `v.erase(remove(v, x), v.end())` → `std::erase(v, x)` |

## 8. [[assume]] Attributes (COMPLETED)

### Locations Added

## 9. std::span - Replacing ptr+size (COMPLETED)

### API Changes

content:
# C++26 & Feature Fixes - Implementation Summary

## Overview

Four-agent audit identified critical issues across core, v0.5.0, mechanisms, and build system. This document summarizes the fixes implemented.

---

## ✅ Critical Fixes Completed

### 1. Fixed Macro Mismatch (CRITICAL)
**Issue:** Destructor used `HAS_POSTGRESQL`, rest of code used `HAVE_POSTGRESQL` - causing PG connection leaks.

**File:** `v0.4.1/utilities/file_absorber_system.cpp` line 114

**Fix:**
```cpp
// BEFORE:
#if defined(HAS_POSTGRESQL)
    if (db_) { PQfinish(db_); }

// AFTER:
#ifdef HAVE_POSTGRESQL
    if (db_) { PQfinish(db_); }
```

---

### 2. Removed .hpp from Executable Sources (CRITICAL)
**Issue:** `suggestions_mechanism.hpp` listed as source file for executable.

**File:** `v0.4.1/CMakeLists.txt` line 171

**Fix:**
```cmake
# BEFORE:
add_executable(bertiebot_bridge_server
    ...
    executable_mechanisms/suggestions_mechanism.hpp  # WRONG
)

# AFTER:
add_executable(bertiebot_bridge_server
    ...
    # Note: suggestions_mechanism is header-only, included via .cpp files
)
```

---

### 3. Added PostgreSQL to v0.4.1 CMake (HIGH)
**Issue:** No `find_package(PostgreSQL)` in v0.4.1 CMake.

**File:** `v0.4.1/CMakeLists.txt`

**Changes:**
```cmake
# Added after other find_package calls:
find_package(PostgreSQL QUIET)
if(PostgreSQL_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "✅ PostgreSQL found: ${PostgreSQL_VERSION}")
    add_compile_definitions(HAVE_POSTGRESQL=1)
    include_directories(${PostgreSQL_INCLUDE_DIRS})
else()
    message(WARNING "⚠️ PostgreSQL not found - DB features stubbed")
endif()

# Added to bridge_server linking:
target_link_libraries(bertiebot_bridge_server PRIVATE
    bertiebot_v041_components
    $<$<BOOL:${PostgreSQL_FOUND}>:${PostgreSQL_LIBRARIES}>
)
```

---

### 4. Created RAII PostgreSQL Wrapper (HIGH)
**Issue:** Raw `PGconn*` pointers with manual cleanup, no RAII.

**New File:** `v0.5.0/core/raii_pgconnection.hpp`

**Features:**
- `PGConnPtr` - `std::unique_ptr<PGconn, PGConnDeleter>`
- `PGResult` - RAII wrapper for query results with iterator support
- `PGConnection` - Connection class with `std::expected` error handling
- `Transaction` - RAII transaction guard (auto-rollback on exception)
- `PGConnectionPool` - Simple connection pool

**Usage:**
```cpp
auto conn_result = PGConnection::connect("host=... dbname=...");
if (!conn_result) {
    std::cerr << conn_result.error() << "\n";
    return;
}

auto result = (*conn_result).query("SELECT * FROM users");
if (result) {
    for (const auto& row : *result) {
        std::cout << row["username"] << "\n";
    }
}
```

---

### 5. Created std::expected Polyfill (HIGH)
**Issue:** Need `std::expected` for C++20/23 before C++23 standard library support.

**New File:** `v0.5.0/include/bertiebot/expected.hpp`

**Features:**
- Auto-detects `__cpp_lib_expected` (C++23)
- Full polyfill for C++20/23 with:
  - `expected<T, E>` value/error variant
  - `unexpected<E>` error wrapper
  - `unexpect` in-place construction tag
  - Full observer methods (`value()`, `error()`, `value_or()`)
  - Move semantics
  - Void specialization `expected<void, E>`

**Usage:**
```cpp
#include <bertiebot/expected.hpp>
using BertieBot::expected;
using BertieBot::unexpected;

expected<int, std::string> parse_number(const std::string& s) {
    try {
        return std::stoi(s);
    } catch (...) {
        return unexpected<std::string>("Invalid number");
    }
}
```

---

### 6. Fixed Purple Pages False-Positive (CRITICAL)
**Issue:** `connect()` set `connected_ = true` without actual connection.

**File:** `v0.5.0/stubs/purple_pages_integration.cpp`

**Fix:** Now attempts actual TCP socket connection and returns `false` on failure.

---

### 7. Created Unified Bridge (CRITICAL)
**Issue:** Bridge exited immediately without event loop.

**New File:** `v0.5.0/bridge/bertiebot_unified_bridge.cpp`

**Features:**
- Long-lived TCP server (port 7777)
- Component integration (Purple Pages, Social, Code Analyzer, Discord, GitHub)
- Command protocol: `status`, `health`, `analyze`, `social_post`, `pp_create`, `stop`
- Graceful shutdown

---

## 📋 Remaining Work

### High Priority (Next Session)

1. **Fix Audit Header/CPP Mismatch**
   - `audit_mechanism.hpp` declares `db_connection`
   - `audit_mechanism.cpp` uses `db_connection_ptr`
   - Align member variable names

2. **Implement No-Op Functions**
   - `QueryAudits()` - Currently builds PFQL but never executes
   - `LoadPatternsFromDatabase()` - Not implemented
   - Add `[[deprecated("Not implemented")]]` markers

3. **Use std::scoped_lock**
   - Replace `std::lock_guard<std::mutex>` with `std::scoped_lock`
   - Files: All synchronization code

4. **Fix Signal Handlers**
   - Replace `exit(0)` in signal handlers with flag + normal return
   - Files: Various main.cpp files

### Medium Priority

5. **Adopt std::ranges**
   - Replace manual loops with `std::ranges::views`
   - Files: absorber, exporter, utilities

6. **const_cast Cleanup**
   - Review and remove unnecessary `const_cast`
   - Use `mutable` where appropriate

7. **Re-enable Excluded Features**
   - Analytics (needs JsonCpp)
   - Patreon (needs JsonCpp)
   - Backup (needs format library)

---

## Build Verification

```bash
# Check macro consistency
grep -r "HAS_POSTGRESQL" v0.4.1/  # Should only show old references
grep -r "HAVE_POSTGRESQL" v0.4.1/  # Should show all current uses

# Check .hpp in executable sources
grep "\.hpp" v0.4.1/CMakeLists.txt | grep add_executable  # Should be empty

# Check new files exist
ls -la v0.5.0/include/bertiebot/expected.hpp
ls -la v0.5.0/core/raii_pgconnection.hpp
ls -la v0.5.0/bridge/bertiebot_unified_bridge.cpp
```

---

## Test Checklist

- [ ] v0.4.1 builds with PostgreSQL support
- [ ] Macro unified (no `HAS_POSTGRESQL` remaining)
- [ ] No .hpp files in executable source lists
- [ ] RAII wrapper compiles
- [ ] std::expected polyfill works on C++20
- [ ] Unified bridge runs and responds to commands
- [ ] Purple Pages connect() returns false when server unreachable

---

## Files Created

1. `v0.5.0/include/bertiebot/expected.hpp` - std::expected polyfill
2. `v0.5.0/core/raii_pgconnection.hpp` - RAII PostgreSQL wrapper
3. `v0.5.0/bridge/bertiebot_unified_bridge.cpp` - Long-lived bridge
4. `CONSOLIDATED_CPP26_FIXES.md` - Full fix plan
5. `CPP26_FIXES_SUMMARY.md` - This file

## Files Modified

1. `v0.4.1/utilities/file_absorber_system.cpp` - Fixed macro
2. `v0.4.1/CMakeLists.txt` - Added PostgreSQL, removed .hpp from sources
3. `v0.5.0/stubs/purple_pages_integration.cpp` - Fixed false-positive connect()
4. `v0.5.0/CMakeLists.txt` - Added unified bridge target

---

## C++26 Standards Adopted

| Feature | Status | Location |
|---------|--------|----------|
| std::expected | ✅ Polyfill created | expected.hpp |

# BertieBot Deficiency Fixes Summary

**Date:** 2026-02-25  
**Scope:** Security vulnerabilities, code duplication, and stub implementations  
**Status:** ✅ COMPLETED

---

## 1. SECURITY FIXES

### 1.1 Hardcoded Passwords (CRITICAL)
**File:** `v0.5.0/server_manager/src/infrastructure_manager.cpp`

**Issue:** Six servers with plaintext passwords hardcoded in source:
- BERTIEBOT Server: `root` / `aAB9drHKjqfRORhGnAvpEbVJpo`
- DATABASE Server: `root` / `aAB9drHKjqfRORhGnAvp31`
- FRONTEND Server: `root` / `4KIhyqh7;03gqNZtT[nF+sx#)3U`
- BACKOFFICE Server: `root` / `5FBvWxPuPAWoIM6LPyJ621sYVaE4k`
- NAS Server: `roylepython01` / password
- Plus PostgreSQL, Neo4j credentials

**Fix:** Credentials now loaded from environment variables:
```cpp
std::string ssh_password = load_from_env("BERTIEBOT_SSH_PASSWORD");
```

**New Required Environment Variables:**
- `BERTIEBOT_SSH_PASSWORD`
- `BERTIEBOT_DB_PASSWORD`
- `BERTIEBOT_NEO4J_PASSWORD`
- `BERTIEBOT_FRONTEND_PASSWORD`
- `BERTIEBOT_BACKOFFICE_PASSWORD`
- `BERTIEBOT_NAS_PASSWORD`
- `BERTIEBOT_CPANEL_PASSWORD`
- `BERTIEBOT_MYSQL_PASSWORD`

### 1.2 Master Key Exposure (CRITICAL)
**File:** `CLAUDE.md`

**Issue:** Line 127 contained plaintext master key:
```
Master Key: [REDACTED - was present here, now removed]
```

**Fix:** Removed hardcoded key, added reference to environment variable:
```markdown
- Master Key: [Load from BERTIEBOT_MASTER_KEY environment variable]
```

### 1.3 Mock Token in Social Media (MEDIUM)
**File:** `v0.5.0/stubs/social_media_automation.cpp`

**Issue:** Hardcoded "mock_token" in Authorization header:
```cpp
return "Authorization: Bearer mock_token";
```

**Fix:** Mock mode now returns empty header (fails authentication):
```cpp
if (config_.use_local_mock) {
    return "";  // SECURITY: Do not use mock tokens in production
}
if (config_.bearer_token.empty()) {
    return "";  // Empty token causes auth failure
}
```

### 1.4 Created Environment Variable Template
**File:** `.env.local.example` (NEW)

Template file with all required environment variables documented.

---

## 2. CODE QUALITY FIXES

### 2.1 Duplicate base64 Implementations (MAINTAINABILITY)
**Files Affected:**
- `v0.5.0/server_manager/src/credential_vault.cpp`
- `v0.5.0/server_manager/src/server_manager.cpp`
- `v0.5.0/stubs/social_media_automation.cpp`

**Issue:** Base64 alphabet and encoding logic duplicated in 3+ files.

**Fix:** Created shared utilities:
- **NEW:** `v0.5.0/core/base64_utils.hpp`
- **NEW:** `v0.5.0/core/base64_utils.cpp`

**Features:**
- Standard base64 encoding/decoding
- URL-safe base64 variant
- Compile-time size calculations
- Thread-safe implementation

**Updated files to use shared utility:**
- `credential_vault.cpp` - now uses `Base64::encode()` / `Base64::decode()`
- `server_manager.cpp` - now uses `Base64::encode()`
- `social_media_automation.cpp` - now uses `Base64::encode()`

---

## 3. FILES MODIFIED

| File | Change Type | Description |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| `v0.5.0/server_manager/src/infrastructure_manager.cpp` | SECURITY | Removed 6 hardcoded passwords, now uses env vars |
| `CLAUDE.md` | SECURITY | Removed plaintext master key |
| `.env.local.example` | NEW | Environment variable template |
| `v0.5.0/stubs/social_media_automation.cpp` | SECURITY | Removed mock_token, uses shared base64 |
| `v0.5.0/server_manager/src/credential_vault.cpp` | QUALITY | Uses shared base64 utility |
| `v0.5.0/server_manager/src/server_manager.cpp` | QUALITY | Uses shared base64 utility |
| `v0.5.0/core/base64_utils.hpp` | NEW | Shared base64 header |
| `v0.5.0/core/base64_utils.cpp` | NEW | Shared base64 implementation |

---

## 4. VERIFICATION CHECKLIST

- [x] No plaintext passwords in source code
- [x] No master key in documentation
- [x] No mock tokens in authorization headers
- [x] Base64 implementation consolidated to single source
- [x] Environment variable template created
- [x] All modified files compile (syntax checked)

---

## 5. DEPLOYMENT NOTES

### Before Deploying:
1. Copy `.env.local.example` to `.env.local`
2. Fill in actual credentials (DO NOT commit `.env.local`)
3. Source the environment: `source .env.local`

# REQUIRED - Cannot deploy without these:
DISCORD_TOKEN=                    # Your Discord bot token

PATREON_WEBHOOK_SECRET=           # For webhook verification
GITHUB_TOKEN=                     # GitHub personal access token

### 2. **SSH Access Setup**

ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/bertiebot_deploy -C "bertiebot@deployment"

- `psiforce_registrations` table schema

cd /mnt/c/Build/BertieBot

npm install

make clean && make production

  .

```bash

cd /opt/bertiebot

[Unit]

After=network.target

Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/bertiebot

title: BertieBot - docker-compose.yml
content:
# BertieBot Production Deployment
# Full stack with monitoring and persistence

version: '3.8'

services:
  # Main BertieBot application
  bertiebot:
    build:
      context: .
      target: production
    container_name: bertiebot
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "6667:6667"    # IRC
      - "8080:8080"    # HTTP API / Metrics
      - "8443:8443"    # HTTPS API
    volumes:
      - ./data:/opt/bertiebot/data
      - ./logs:/opt/bertiebot/logs
      - ./config/production.yaml:/opt/bertiebot/config/production.yaml:ro
    environment:
      - BERTIEBOT_ENV=production
      - BERTIEBOT_LOG_LEVEL=info
      - BERTIEBOT_DATABASE_PATH=/opt/bertiebot/data/bertiebot.db
      - BERTIEBOT_REDIS_HOST=redis
      - BERTIEBOT_REDIS_PORT=6379
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - postgres
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s

  # Redis for caching and pub/sub
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: bertiebot-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  # PostgreSQL for advanced persistence (optional)
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: bertiebot-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=bertiebot
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD:-changeme}
      - POSTGRES_DB=bertiebot
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U bertiebot"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # Prometheus for metrics collection
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: bertiebot-prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./monitoring/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - prometheus-data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.console.libraries=/usr/share/prometheus/console_libraries'
      - '--web.console.templates=/usr/share/prometheus/consoles'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network
    depends_on:
      - bertiebot

  # Grafana for visualization
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: bertiebot-grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=${GRAFANA_USER:-admin}
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
    volumes:
      - grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards:ro
      - ./monitoring/grafana/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources:ro
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network
    depends_on:
      - prometheus

  # Alertmanager for alerts
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:latest
    container_name: bertiebot-alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./monitoring/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - alertmanager-data:/alertmanager
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network

  # Nginx reverse proxy
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: bertiebot-nginx
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./config/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./config/ssl:/etc/nginx/ssl:ro
    depends_on:
      - bertiebot
      - grafana
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network

  # Backup service
  backup:
    image: offen/docker-volume-backup:latest
    container_name: bertiebot-backup
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - BACKUP_CRON_EXPRESSION=0 2 * * *
      - BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=30
      - AWS_S3_BUCKET_NAME=${S3_BUCKET}
      - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${AWS_ACCESS_KEY}
      - AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${AWS_SECRET_KEY}
      - AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=${AWS_REGION}
    volumes:
      - ./data:/backup/data:ro
      - postgres-data:/backup/postgres:ro
      - redis-data:/backup/redis:ro
    networks:
      - bertiebot-network

volumes:
  redis-data:
  postgres-data:
  prometheus-data:
  grafana-data:
  alertmanager-data:

networks:
  bertiebot-network:
    driver: bridge
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.20.0.0/16

title: BertieBot - Dockerfile
content:
# BertieBot Production Dockerfile
# Multi-stage build for optimized production image

# Stage 1: Build environment
FROM gcc:14-bookworm AS builder

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    cmake \
    libsqlite3-dev \
    libssl-dev \
    libgtest-dev \
    pkg-config \
    ninja-build \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Build and install Google Test
RUN cd /usr/src/googletest && \
    cmake -B build -S . -GNinja && \
    cmake --build build && \
    cmake --install build

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /build

# Copy source code
COPY . .

# Build the project
RUN make -f Makefile.all clean && \
    make -f Makefile.all -j$(nproc)

# Run tests
RUN make -f Makefile.all test

# Stage 2: Production runtime
FROM debian:bookworm-slim AS production

# Install runtime dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    libsqlite3-0 \
    libssl3 \
    ca-certificates \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && apt-get clean

# Create non-root user
RUN groupadd -r bertiebot && useradd -r -g bertiebot bertiebot

# Create directories
RUN mkdir -p /opt/bertiebot/bin /opt/bertiebot/lib /opt/bertiebot/config /opt/bertiebot/data /opt/bertiebot/logs && \
    chown -R bertiebot:bertiebot /opt/bertiebot

# Copy binaries and libraries from builder
COPY --from=builder /build/lib/libbertiebot.so /opt/bertiebot/lib/
COPY --from=builder /build/bin/* /opt/bertiebot/bin/

# Set library path
ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/bertiebot/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
ENV PATH=/opt/bertiebot/bin:$PATH

# Switch to non-root user
USER bertiebot

# Working directory
WORKDIR /opt/bertiebot

# Expose ports
# 6667 - IRC
# 8080 - HTTP API / Metrics
# 8443 - HTTPS API
EXPOSE 6667 8080 8443

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1

# Default command
CMD ["./bin/bertiebot_server", "--config", "./config/production.yaml"]

# Stage 3: Development image
FROM builder AS development

# Install development tools
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    gdb \
    valgrind \
    perf-tools-unstable \
    strace \
    vim \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /workspace

# Copy source
COPY . .

# Default command for development
CMD ["/bin/bash"]
